gloss: to jump onto; to hop on; to leap aboard

definitions.gloss: to jump onto; to hop aboard (a train, bus, horse)
definitions.explanation: To get onto something in one quick leap, typically a vehicle that is about to leave or already moving. The nuance is haste, not athletic skill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}った。
⟦{発車|はっしゃ}→発車：03694_hassha⟧まぎわ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}る。
examples.english: To hop onto a bus just as it is pulling out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}まっていた→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}って⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: On getting the news, I jumped into a taxi parked nearby and headed for the hospital.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to jump, to fly) and ⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to board, to ride). The thing boarded is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the vehicle, not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}る, never ✗⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}る.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}る: to jump onto a train
- ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}る: to hop on a bicycle
- ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{乗|の}る: to leap onto a horse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飛|と}び{降|お}りる→飛び降りる：06734_tobioriru⟧: to jump off — the paired opposite
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧: to rush in — running into a train or building, without the leap
